title: Revit Category and Subcategory Graphics
purpose: Apply category/subcategory graphics through governed Object Styles, view templates, and rule-based filters while minimizing uncontrolled per-view or per-element overrides.
preconditions: The project is aligned to the governed Revit template and approved category/subcategory definitions.
Applicable view templates are available for the intended documentation or coordination purpose.

steps.name: Use Object Styles as the baseline source
actions: Use Object Styles for baseline category and subcategory line weight, line pattern, color, and material-driven display where applicable.
Do not redefine baseline category graphics independently in individual views.
validation: Project Object Styles align with the governed template/source.
Baseline graphics do not depend on undocumented per-view overrides.

steps.name: Control scoped display through view templates and filters
actions: Apply approved view templates for view-specific category visibility and graphics.
Use rule-based filters for recurring parameter-driven exceptions.
If a recurring manual override is needed, route it into governed template/filter logic instead of repeating it ad hoc.
validation: Recurring display logic is reproducible through templates/filters.
Uncontrolled per-element overrides are absent or recorded as explicit exceptions.

steps.name: Use only approved subcategories in detail/content families
actions: Verify detail items and families use governed subcategories where such subcategories exist.
Treat proposed numeric lineweights, pattern scales, or example subcategory names from source tables as noncanonical unless separately governed.
validation: No unapproved subcategory proliferation is introduced.
Family/detail graphics resolve through governed subcategory definitions.

outputs: Consistent category/subcategory graphics controlled by templates, Object Styles, and governed filters
future_dependencies: Concrete governed Object Styles/Line Weights registry
Complete governed subcategory catalogue where required
governance_notes: Object Styles are the baseline source; view templates and filters provide scoped display behavior.
Source numeric graphics values and example pattern names remain unconfirmed and are not promoted.

provenance.source_title: Category & Subcategory Graphics Standards and Guidelines
provenance.migration_note: Migrated durable graphics-control hierarchy; numeric/example values remain noncanonical.
